sites.name: Regional Command Headquarters Base Relic (Ta Thiet Base)
sites.event: Known as the 'Government Forest', the residence and workplace of senior leaders of the Command of the People's Liberation Armed Forces of South Vietnam during the resistance war against the US.

sites.name: Soc Bom Bo
sites.event: Famous for the song 'Tiếng chày trên sóc Bom Bo', marking the patriotism and contributions of the S'tieng ethnic people during the resistance war.

sites.name: Ba Ra Mountain - Thac Mo Lake
sites.event: The highest mountain in the province (723m), associated with the heroic resistance of the Phuoc Long army and people and the Ba Ra prison during the French colonial period.

place.commune: Son Giang Ward, Thac Mo Ward

sites.name: Bu Gia Map National Park
sites.event: A vast primeval forest, conserving rare gene sources of flora and fauna in the Southeast region.

sites.name: Phu Rieng Do Relic
sites.event: The founding place of the first Communist Party cell in the Southeast region (October 28, 1929), initiating the struggle movement of rubber workers.

sites.name: Bu Lach Grassland
sites.event: A vast natural grassland surrounding a lake, with a pristine landscape compared to a green steppe in the middle of the vast forest.

sites.name: Mass Grave of 3,000 People
sites.event: The place marking war crimes and the sacrifice of more than 3,000 compatriots and soldiers during the Nguyen Hue campaign (Summer 1972) in An Loc.

sites.name: Phat Quoc Van Thanh Pagoda
sites.event: Famous for the 73m-high sitting Shakyamuni Buddha statue, considered one of the tallest sitting Buddha statues in Southeast Asia.

sites.name: Thac Dung
sites.event: A beautiful and majestic waterfall of Dak Woh stream, bearing the pristine beauty of the Bu Dang mountains and forests.

sites.name: Song Be Broken Bridge
sites.event: A tragic and heroic historical relic destroyed by the US military in 1975 to block the advance of the liberation army.

place.commune: Tan Khai Commune (bordering Hung Chien Ward)

sites.name: Voi Waterfall
sites.event: Associated with the legend of a herd of white elephants helping people extinguish a fierce forest fire.
